key_concepts: Atoms are the smallest unit of matter that retains the identity of a substance
Protons are positively charged and located in the nucleus
Neutrons have no charge and are located in the nucleus
Electrons are negatively charged and located outside the nucleus
The nucleus is small, dense, and contains most of the atom's mass
Stable neutral atoms have equal numbers of protons and electrons
Protons and neutrons are called nucleons
Conductors allow electrons to flow freely while insulators block electron flow
J.J. Thomson proposed the plum pudding model and Rutherford's gold foil experiment reveale
Atomic number equals the number of protons and mass number equals protons plus neutrons
Ions form by gaining or losing electrons; isotopes have the same protons but different neu
